title: mistral-soleng-field-scratch
content:
Context: onboarding call with Mistral Health (PHI-sensitive) next week. Customer wants VPC-hosted Redwood Private with HSM-backed keys and strict egress rules. Goal: have an initial private deployment POC in their staging VPC, run simple LLM chat demo, validate latency < 120ms p95 on 512-token window, and validate audit logs to their Splunk forwarder.

High-level plan (one-pager for call):
- Day 0: network and IAM kickoff (customer infra + SE).
- Day 1–2: terraform skeleton + VPC peering and route checks.
- Day 3: deploy control plane components (air-gapped option flagged).
- Day 4: deploy inference nodes, test model load.
- Day 5: run perf tests, enable prefix cache, validate fallbacks.

Quick TODO (today):
- [ ] Share minimal terraform repo stub (PR #42) with customer and mark variables required (vpc_id, subnet_ids, cidr_allowlist). -- Jon to send by EOD.
- [ ] Confirm HSM/KMS alias naming convention with security. Suggested alias: projects/mistral/keys/redwood-mistral-prod. -- Samira to ask security.
- [ ] Draft canary rollout plan: start 5% traffic for 24h, 20% next 24h, 100% at 72h if no regressions. Include automatic rollback on error_rate > 0.5% or latency regression > 15%. -- Priya to draft.
- [ ] Prepare list of logs/events to forward to Splunk (token-level usage, model_version, request_id, client_id). -- Evan to compile.

Commands / quick snippets to paste to customer chat:
- Verify node status: kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=redwood-inference
- Check logs (control plane): kubectl -n redwood logs deployment/redwood-control --since=1h | grep "ERROR"
- Simple perf run (local): curl -s -X POST https://private-api.mistral.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-v2-small","input":"hello"}' | jq -r '.latency_ms'

Config notes / recommended defaults for POC:
- Model: rwd-v2-small (float16) for initial smoke; rwd-v2-medium with 4-bit quant for cost test.
- Batch size: start 8 for GPU A100 with concurrency 6; tune by observing token latency.
- KV cache: enable prefix caching for repeated chat sessions, TTL 2h. (Doc: CONFLUENCE-4598, section Cache knobs)
- Autoscale: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8 for staging; use cpu/gpu util target 60%
- Network egress: all outbound to model registries blocked; allowlist for container registry only (gcr+redwood internal).
- Ports: 443 for API, 9411 for tracing (zipkin endpoint to customer's trace collector).

Security checklist (must complete before prod run):
- KMS: create HSM-backed key; policy must allow service account: redwood-private-svc@customer. Use least-privilege.
- Audit logs: enable full request/response metadata (PII redaction option). Discuss retention policy (default 90d).
- SSO: link to customer's OIDC provider for console access (SCIM optional).
- Pen test window: schedule after initial deployment (customer asks for third-party pentest).

Canary / fallback wiring notes:
- Route config: route by header x-mistral-tier: canary|stable. Default to stable if header missing.
- Fallback: if target model fails healthcheck, route to rwd-v2-small-fallback (quantized) with 10% sampling.
- Circuit breaker: open if 5xx rate > 1% over 5m across cluster.

Risks / unknowns (open questions):
- Customer expects <120ms p95 at 512 tokens — need to verify queueing behavior under concurrency. Might require dedicated pool + smaller batch sizes.
- HSM throughput constraints — ask infra/security if HSM ops/sec limits could affect key unwrapping at scale.
- Splunk ingestion cost — confirm which events they actually want; we should suggest sampled detailed events (1%) + full metadata for errors.

Meeting prep: 1) slides: brief arch diagram, roles/contacts, timeline, minimal support T&Cs. 2) Bring up the terraform skeleton in the demo and show how variables map to their VPC. 3) Have a quick perf run ready (rwd-v2-small) and a scripted failure to demo fallback.

Notes to self / followups after call:
- Collect customer's VPC CIDR, list of subnets, bastion IPs for access window.
- Confirm their Splunk HEC endpoint + token rotation schedule.
- Set up internal RFC for HSM usage pattern (attach sample key ACL) and route to security for approval.
- Put together a runbook for on-call (pager escalation for model OOMs / high latency).

Session log template (for customer-facing recap):
- Date: 
- Attendees: 
- Decisions made: e.g., use rwd-v2-small for POC, HSM required, canary windows agreed.
- Action items and owners: (link to JIRA ids).

Unresolved (nice-to-have later):
- ability to do model-level token redaction before logs hit exporter (avoid PII leakage).
- cheaper quantization path for smaller models on CPU-only nodes.

End of scratch — put this into a short email + PR to kickoff infra. Keep this doc as living notes and move finalized items into Confluence page after the call.
notes_summary: POC plan and checklist for Mistral Health private deployment: network/IAM, HSM/KMS, canary plan, perf targets, logging, open risks.
